thread:
ryan: Hey team — first day! Quick map: who do I page for (1) model process crashes, (2) GPU node OOMs, (3) rollout config mistakes? Also who approves dev-gpu and PagerDuty for new hires?

maya: welcome!! :tada: short: (1) eng-runtime on-call, (2) eng-sre on-call, (3) eng-platform on-call. For access: submit https://redwood.internal/access-request (choose 'dev-gpu'). PagerDuty additions need manager sign-off + shadowing.

ash: small nuance: if the model is producing bad outputs (quality/regression) loop in ML-evals + eng-platform. If it's resource/memory, page eng-sre. If it's the model binary crashing -> eng-runtime.

ryan: thanks — where are the runbooks and an owners list?

people-ops: Runbooks: https://redwood.internal/runbooks. Ownership matrix in handbook: https://redwood.internal/handbook/ownership-matrix. If you lack perms, reply here and we'll fast-track after manager approval.

oncall-bot: Escalation TL;DR:
```
1) post in #incidents + tag team on-call
2) 0-5m: primary ack expected
3) 5-15m: escalate to secondary & add incident channel
4) 15m+: call incident commander + exec on-call
Security incidents: page eng-security immediately
```

maya: pro tip: prefix messages with "rollback" for urgent deploy rollbacks so the rollout bot posts the checklist. If you're shadowing, say so and someone will guide you.

ryan: awesome, filing the access request now and I'll ping my manager for sign-off on PagerDuty. Thanks all! :raised_hands:
